technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX 41.49, Ichimoku bullish) undermined by extreme overbought conditions across all RSI/Stoch/UO oscillators with declining momentum confirmation; high pullback risk despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 83 days to next report.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with Republican senior member purchases offset by Democratic sale
sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; neutral market fear/greed, mixed congressional activity (two Republican purchases vs. one Democratic sale 81 days ago), and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (352.8), and recent CPI miss create hostile environment for IT equities despite 83-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 41.49 + Ichimoku bullish + Supertrend bullish establish strong trend structure with price near support (431.28), offering defined risk entry for trend continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across all oscillators (RSI-9/14, Stoch, UO, Williams %R) with declining momentum confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, hostile macro (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), and price below 50/200 EMAs create high pullback risk that negates technical strength.
